headline: More than 20 NHS trusts have stopped using Palantir's waiting-list software, according to an analysis reported by the Financial Times.
score_reason: Pool score 6 lowered by 1: only the headline could be read, so the details are unverified.
importance_line: Patients waiting for NHS care and the trusts (the local organisations that run NHS hospitals in England) may be affected, as may Palantir, but the reasons and the exact tools involved are not known.
summary: The Financial Times reports, based on an analysis, that more than 20 NHS trusts have stopped using Palantir's software for managing hospital waiting lists.
